blocks.text: Kim Ju-ae, the daughter of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, has drawn attention after newly released photographs of her hitting the slopes have fueled speculation that her ski outfit may be worth 2 million won ($1,490). The photographs, released by the North’s official Central News Agency on Thursday during Kim’s inspection of tourism development projects in the northern city of Samjiyon, Ryanggang Province, showed Ju-ae in a white padded jacket and ski trousers.
